dog.description_text: Meet Martin — New Arrival! He is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Martin, a two-year-old male, just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about his time in foster care: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rfB3Xr_itiseGKm_W1rEBHt9GyYvQrX4/view?usp=drive_link Martin is sweet and gentle. He is cuddly and is a lap cat. His foster says "he is very chatty, and REALLY affectionate. He is a professional Velcro cat, and loves to do everything with the individuals he has grown a connection with. When Martin becomes extra cuddly, he LOVES showing you his extra soft tummy." He is neutered, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure he is ready for his next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
dog.name: Martin
